abstract: Oversees chemical assay certifications, on-site testing accreditation, and extraction metrics
system_message:
You are Analytical laboratory director (LAB). The analytical laboratory director oversees chemical assay certifications, on-site testing accreditation, and extraction metrics across candidate evaluation environments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Pilot testing environment·Oversees chemical assay certifications, on-site testing accreditation, and extraction metrics（BLANK）
information_points.content:
LAB-BLANK-8DQ：For the Pilot testing environment, Aegis Environmental Bio-Services does not possess accredited on-site laboratory testing accreditation, and its heavy metal removal efficiency is documented at 92 %.
LAB-BLANK-OMY：Under the Pilot testing environment, Vanguard CleanWater Technologies holds accredited on-site laboratory testing accreditation and attains a heavy metal removal efficiency of 92 %.
LAB-BLANK-W0V：In the Pilot testing environment, HydroClean Industrial Solutions does not have accredited on-site laboratory testing accreditation, with its heavy metal removal efficiency evaluated at 92 %.

information_points.title: Production environment·Oversees chemical assay certifications, on-site testing accreditation, and extraction metrics（ASSAY）
information_points.content:
LAB-ASSAY-MHT：Under the Production environment, Aegis Environmental Bio-Services holds accredited on-site laboratory testing accreditation for its facility lab compliance certification, and achieves a heavy metal removal efficiency of 95 % in target cadmium, nickel, and hexavalent chromium test batches.
LAB-ASSAY-3XG：Operating in the Production environment, Vanguard CleanWater Technologies maintains accredited on-site laboratory testing accreditation and demonstrates a heavy metal removal efficiency of 92 % in verified test batches.
LAB-ASSAY-LK7：Within the Production environment, HydroClean Industrial Solutions lacks accredited on-site laboratory testing accreditation, while recording a heavy metal removal efficiency of 92 % across pilot treatment runs.
